title: Draw the king onto f8
text: First clear g6 with Nf6+. Then sacrifice the queen on f8 to lure the king onto that square. Bh6+ forces the king back to g8, and Re8 finishes the attack.
demonstration: Nf6+ gxf6 Qf8+ Kxf8 Bh6+ Kg8 Re8#

title: Decoy and knight fork
text: The pawn check draws either the queen or king onto f7. The knight then forks king and queen, winning material.

title: Decoy and pin
text: Bd4 pins the queen to its king. Capturing the bishop draws the queen onto d4, where Nb5+ forks king and queen.
